waze-inspired-dark.label: Waze-inspired Dark
waze-inspired-dark.description: Initial dark navy and blue-grey map palette inspired by Waze night-map styling. These are Wemaps values, not official Waze design tokens.

violet-night.label: Violet Night
violet-night.description: Alternative purple map palette retained for future use.

customOverrides.description: Optional user-defined semantic color overrides. Empty by default. Unknown token names must be ignored safely.

notes: Map layers must reference semantic tokens rather than embedding color literals.
Changing a preset or custom token must not change map geometry, OSM data, or rendering algorithms.
Lane compatibility colors are used only when route and lane matching data are available.
Mapped physical road width, estimated width, and renderer fallback width are separate data states.
